usage: the all-purpose measure word: people, everyday objects, and most nouns that have no special measure word (一个星期).
example: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。
exampleEn: I have an older brother and a younger sister.

usage: for clothes and luggage (一件衣服), and for matters or things to do (一件小事).
exampleEn: I bought a new piece of clothing.

usage: for animals (cats, dogs, birds) and one of a pair (一只鞋, 一只袜子).
exampleEn: My family has a puppy.

usage: for family members (几口人), wells (一口井) and things with an opening such as a wok (一口锅).
exampleEn: There are five people in my family.

usage: for businesses and institutions (一家公司, 一家饭店) and families (一家人).
exampleEn: The food at this restaurant is very tasty.

usage: for books, dictionaries, magazines and other bound volumes.
exampleEn: This book is very interesting.

usage: yuan, the main unit of Chinese money (formal or written form; in speech 块 is more common).
exampleEn: This book costs twenty yuan.

usage: 1) (colloquial) yuan, the same as 元: 三块钱 2) a lump or piece: 一块蛋糕, 一块石头.
example: 我用三块钱买了一瓶水。
exampleEn: I bought a bottle of water for three yuan.

usage: day, as a span or count (三天 = three days).
exampleEn: I rested for a whole day yesterday.

usage: day, the formal or written form of 天, used in dates (三月八日) and set phrases (一日三餐).
exampleEn: May 1 is Labor Day.

usage: year, as a span or count (三年 = three years) and in dates.
exampleEn: I have been studying Chinese for a year.

usage: month — always counted with 个 (一个月, 两个月).
exampleEn: I lived in Beijing for two months.

usage: years of age (三岁 = three years old); asked with 几岁.
exampleEn: My little sister is five years old this year.

usage: hour, counted with 个 (一个小时, 半个小时).
exampleEn: I sleep eight hours every day.

usage: minute, as a duration (十分钟 = ten minutes); for clock time use 分.
exampleEn: Please wait for me for five minutes.

usage: minutes when telling clock time, after 点 (六点十分); for a duration say 分钟 instead.
exampleEn: I get up at ten past six in the morning.

usage: o'clock (几点 = what time? 三点 = three o'clock).
exampleEn: What time is it now? It is three o'clock.

usage: a brief action placed after a verb: 看一下 (take a look), 等一下 (wait a moment).
exampleEn: Please wait a moment; I will be right there.

usage: some, a few — an indefinite plural before nouns (一些人); also 有些.
exampleEn: There is some fruit on the table.

usage: a cup or glass of (一杯茶, 一杯水).
exampleEn: I would like a cup of hot tea.

usage: a vehicle-load of (一车苹果 = a truckload of apples).
exampleEn: This truckload of watermelons is very sweet.

usage: a table-full of people or dishes (一桌菜, 一桌人).
example: 这一桌菜都是妈妈做的。
exampleEn: This whole table of dishes was made by Mom.
